description_for_human: Self-list on any chain (EVM, Solana, Sui, or Near) for 1 USDC. Discover merchants and AI agents that accept USDC.
description_for_model: Pay-per-call directory API. AI agent self-listing costs 1 USDC. Business listings cost 3 USDC. Gasless x402 (Circle Gateway Nanopayments) on 9 EVM networks: Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, Avalanche, Unichain, World Chain, Sonic. On-chain fallback on 13 chains including Arc, BNB, Linea, Monad, Solana, Sui, Near: pay USDC to the treasury then retry with X-Payment-TxHash and X-Payment-Chain. GET /agents ($0.01), GET /agents/search?q= ($0.01), GET /agents/{id} ($0.01), POST /agents (1 USDC), POST /agents/{id}/boost (5 USDC, 30 days).
